      "evidence": "Adds serialization helpers to src/serialize.h to support direct zero-allocation deserialization.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "speedup",
      "rationale": "Extends serialization primitives in src/serialize.h to allow direct buffer deserialization without intermediate heap allocations. It provides a helpful serialization primitive, though its primary driver is the script witness optimization."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Optimizes CScriptWitness and script interpreter execution paths in src/script/interpreter.cpp and src/script/script.cpp.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "speedup",
      "rationale": "Significantly speeds up block deserialization and validation for blocks with large numbers of witness elements, reducing benchmarked runtimes from 275–316ms to 21ms. Eliminating eager vector allocations and caching stack offsets limits potential validation-time CPU bottlenecks and memory churn on synthetic or pathological witness loads."
